description: The pie chart compares the proportions of two categories related to time measurements. The chart is divided into two slices, with "Reduction" represented by an orange slice occupying approximately 69.92% of the chart, and "Efficient deployment" represented by a blue slice making up around 30.08%. The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, along with corresponding time values in seconds. One slice, "Reduction", is visually emphasized by being larger and having a more prominent label, while the other slice is offset or "exploded" from the rest of the pie chart. The chart does not include a separate legend, as the labels are directly associated with their respective slices. The slices are arranged with the larger slice first, followed by the smaller slice.
